rows.basis: The May 29, 2025 earnings release says Micron is making 'disciplined investments' in technology and manufacturing 'to satisfy growing AI-driven memory demand'. It is a company-wide qualitative statement with no HBM/AI share or amount of capex, so no number is attributable. Seller-side signal, not in ai_amount: Cloud Memory (CMBU) revenue was 13,524M in FY2025, up from 3,792M in FY2024.

FY2025 capex was 15,857M in total. The only statement, an in-year outlook, ties the investment to AI-driven memory demand in words only, with no stated HBM/AI share or amount, so the AI part cannot be quantified. Seller-side signal, not in ai_amount: CMBU revenue was 13,524M.
